name: ReportGenerator
description: Creates coverage reports from tools like OpenCover, dotCover, Visual Studio, NCover, Cobertura, JaCoCo, Clover, gcov or lcov

reports.description: The coverage reports that should be parsed (separated by semicolon). Globbing is supported.

targetdir.description: The directory where the generated report should be saved.

reporttypes.description: The output formats and scope (separated by semicolon) Values: Badges, Clover, Cobertura, CsvSummary, Html, HtmlChart, HtmlInline, HtmlInline_AzurePipelines, Htm

sourcedirs.description: Optional directories which contain the corresponding source code (separated by semicolon). The source directories are used if coverage report contains classes w

historydir.description: Optional directory for storing persistent coverage information. Can be used in future reports to show coverage evolution.

workingdir.description: Optional working directory. If available, the targetdir, sourcedirs and historydir are interpreted relative to the working directory (only if not specified as a

toolpath.description: Default directory for installing the dotnet tool.

plugins.description: Optional plugin files for custom reports or custom history storage (separated by semicolon).

assemblyfilters.description: Optional list of assemblies that should be included or excluded in the report. Exclusion filters take precedence over inclusion filters. Wildcards are allowed.

classfilters.description: Optional list of classes that should be included or excluded in the report. Exclusion filters take precedence over inclusion filters. Wildcards are allowed.

filefilters.description: Optional list of files that should be included or excluded in the report. Exclusion filters take precedence over inclusion filters. Wildcards are allowed.

riskhotspotassemblyfilters.description: Optional list of assemblies that should be included or excluded in the risk hotspots. Exclusion filters take precedence over inclusion filters. Wildcards are al

riskhotspotclassfilters.description: Optional list of classes that should be included or excluded in the risk hotspots. Exclusion filters take precedence over inclusion filters. Wildcards are allow

verbosity.description: The verbosity level of the log messages. Values: Verbose, Info, Warning, Error, Off

license.description: Optional license for PRO version. Get your license here: https://reportgenerator.io/pro

customSettings.description: Optional custom settings (separated by semicolon). See: https://github.com/danielpalme/ReportGenerator/wiki/Settings
